integration_changes: Build-only staging directory and explicit compile-job limit added to driver/build.sh; upstream register patches preserved.
activation: Root scripts/gen2-second-pass.sh remains authoritative; upstream gen2 hammer disabled by install-driver.sh.

p2p.adaptations: Four optional patches; preserve 615 chipset-check assignment and IOVAS diagnostics; omit unrelated Blackwell/global ReBAR edits; refuse mixed NVIDIA hosts; actual peer read/write checker.

hbm_control.adaptations: Optional patch opens five HBM PLMs and sizes the PLM loop from its table only when enabled. No frequency/timing changes, 170tune installation or idle-power daemon.

changes.effect: Additional SM/TPC floorsweep restoration; hardware validation required.
DRAM/SRAM ECC enablement and reporting; may affect usable memory and performance.
Restricts ECC overrides/reporting to CMP 170HX instead of other GPU models.
Adds support for NVIDIA 615.71.09; installer still matches installed userspace driver.
Optional VFIO/GSP state preservation helpers; not enabled by our AI-host installer.
CMP SKU mask changes intended to allow GPU profiling.
Leaves high reserved memory backing WPR2 reserved.

live_host_200.observation: Baseline before the 2026-10-07 driver deployment and reboot.
live_host_200.root_cause: cmp170-gen2-second-pass.service expected 1 GPU but enumerated 4; exited before activation.
live_host_200.link_under_load: All 4 GPUs: Gen1 x4, 96% GPU utilization.

deployment_host_200.service_result: success, ExecMainStatus=0, PASS for all four automatically detected cards
deployment_host_200.ecc_report: nvidia-smi -q -d ECC: Current and Pending Enabled on all four cards; all reported volatile/aggregate DRAM/SRAM error counts 0, repair flags No. Reporting-only observation, not independent proof of working ECC.
deployment_host_200.validation: Post-reboot Torch device properties confirmed 74 SM per GPU versus 70 before. All four cards retained 65536 MiB and reached Gen2 x4. Panel health is HTTP 200, MCP port is reachable, all six running containers returned. Mining automatically resumed on all four cards; no additional GPU test was injected into that workload.
deployment_host_200.limits: No sustained stability or inference throughput benchmark yet. ECC reports Enabled, but the upstream patch overrides reporting, so this alone does not prove hardware ECC correctness.
